## Overview

SUNRISE - Safety assUraNce fRamework for connected, automated mobIlity
SystEms - is a Horizon Europe project building a safety assurance framework
for connected and automated mobility (CCAM). Rather than certifying a single
autonomous driving stack in isolation, SUNRISE develops methods to rank and
validate the safety of different automated agents (planners, controllers,
perception stacks) against each other, so that safety claims can be compared
on common ground.

## What I worked on

My contribution sits on the assurance side: contributing to the framework
that ranks agents by how safely they behave across a set of scenarios,
rather than by a single pass/fail metric. The intent is a framework that
generalizes across vehicle types and automation levels, not one tuned to a
single platform.

## Status

Ongoing, 2024 - 2025, University of Trento.
